note: What a server sends to put a lasting effect on a unit. The header names the unit carrying the effect, which can differ from the caster named inside.

fields.name: slot
fields.note: Which of the unit's effect slots it sits in. A client ignores the message where it is above 63.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: What sort of effect it is.

fields.name: count
fields.note: How many of it are stacked there.

fields.name: hidden
fields.note: Whether the client keeps it off the unit's display. A client hides it only for 1 and shows it for any other value.

fields.name: effect
fields.note: Which effect, by the number its name gives, as spec/objects.md works it out. A server never sends zero. A client adds nothing for an effect it does not know.

fields.name: runningFor
fields.note: How long it has already run, in seconds.

fields.name: lasts
fields.note: How long it runs in total, in seconds.

fields.name: caster
fields.note: The unit that put it there.
